mapper.select: SELECT w.svc_num, w.cust_name, w.contact_man, w.contact_phone, w.developer_name, w.scheme_name, w.lvl_name, w.service_name, w.conn_type, w.amount_per_year, w.eff_time, w.exp_time, w.rate_, w.user_addr, w.exte_flag, w.new_scheme_id, w.new_scheme_name, w.new_create_time, w.new_eff_time, w.new_exp_time, w.new_scheme_period, w.new_scheme_fee, w.relation_type_name, fw.user_status FROM wide_sys_auto_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning fw ON w.ORDER_FLOW_NO = fw.ORDER_FLOW_NO WHERE w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} AND DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y%m%d') = #{targetDate} AND w.exte_flag = 0 ORDER BY w.id ASC

SELECT w.svc_num, w.cust_name, w.contact_man, w.contact_phone, w.developer_name, w.scheme_name, w.lvl_name, w.service_name, w.conn_type, w.amount_per_year, DATE_FORMAT(w.eff_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') eff_time, DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') exp_time, w.rate_, w.user_addr, w.exte_flag, w.new_scheme_id, w.new_scheme_name, DATE_FORMAT(w.new_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') new_create_time, DATE_FORMAT(w.new_eff_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') new_eff_time, DATE_FORMAT(w.new_exp_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') new_exp_time, w.new_scheme_period, w.new_scheme_fee, w.relation_type_name, fw.user_status FROM wide_sys_auto_warning w LEFT JOIN ftp_tc_user_cycle_warning fw ON w.ORDER_FLOW_NO = fw.ORDER_FLOW_NO WHERE w.main_order_flow_no = #{mainOrderFlowNo} AND DATE_FORMAT(w.exp_time, '%Y%m%d') = #{targetDate} ORDER BY w.id ASC
